## 主张 Claim

在共同 Process/Trace 中，真实活动留下的失配地址修改保留的接触序列；控制器按新序列取得绑定的双参考值，检查分离后安装新记录，后续实际回应随之改变。第二次失配再次修改方法并使用新装置，全程支持不重置。计划、参考、安装和使用各有检查声明；新的已安装接触接回原 Through，旧选择保留直接复用 P93。冻结旧方法、擦除记录、支持不足、常值参考及检查后漂移保留失败。 / Within the shared Process/Trace, an acquired mismatch address revises a retained contact sequence. The controller executes it, acquires bound reference pairs, checks separation, installs fresh records and changes actual later response. A second mismatch revises the method again without resetting support. Plan, reference, installation and use handoffs are checked; new installed contacts reuse Through and old-choice preservation directly reuses P93. Frozen methods, erased receipts, insufficient support, constant references and post-check drift retain failures.
